data.name: Kafila
data.gender_notes: Kafila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Traveler on the path to God
data.long_meaning: A woman who journeys towards Allah, carrying the faith and spreading guidance. The name Kafila carries the meaning “Traveler on the path to God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kafila usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler on the path to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A pilgrim on the spiritual journey to Allah
data.etymology: Kafila belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler on the path to God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kafila total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كافِلَة
in_arabic.meaning: المسافر الجاد، الراكب، السائح، المهاجر، المستوطن
in_arabic.long_meaning: الكافِلَة: هو الشخص الذي يتولى مهمة النقل أو السفر مع مجموعة من الأشخاص، أو الذي يترك بيته ويتوجه إلى مكان آخر للعمل أو الهجرة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم الأسماء في الإسلام، حيث كان للنبي محمد عليه السلام كافِلَةً لبعض صحابه، وكان يطلق عليه هذا الاسم بسبب رحلاته مع الصحابة. يعتبر الكافِلَةُ أيضًا اسمًا للفرد الذي يبني أو يزود في بناء المساجد.

in_urdu.name: کافِلہ
in_urdu.meaning: مسافر جاد، رکن، سیاح، مہاجر، مستنصر
in_urdu.long_meaning: کافِلہ: یہ نام کسی شخص کو دیتا ہے جو سفر کے لیے جادہ ہو اور گروپ کے ساتھ سفر کرے، یا جو اپنے گھر سے چلے جائیں اور کسی دوسرے شہر میں رہنے کی کوشش کریں۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایت کا شاندار نمونہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: काफिला
in_hindi.meaning: सफ़र करने वाला, राही यात्री, सैलाबी, मौजनी, साथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: काफिला: यह नाम तीर्थयात्रियों के एक समूह को दिया जाता है, जो एक ही समय में एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर जाते हैं। यह नाम इस्लामिक परंपरा का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है।

in_pashto.name: کافِلہ
in_pashto.meaning: سفر کوړونکی، لړ کړونکی، د پيل کولوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: کافِلہ: دا نوم دا هغه وګړي ته ورکولای شي چې سفر ته ځي یا لړ کړي. په افغانستان او د پښتونو کې دا نوم د اسلامي رواج د څانګوته په ګډون کوي.

in_english.name: Kafila
in_english.long_meaning: Kafila: a traveler, a caravan, a migrant, or a pilgrim. In Islamic tradition, the name Kafila has a significant meaning. It refers to the group of people who travel together, often for religious or spiritual purposes. The name is also associated with the concept of hijra, or migration, which is an important event in Islamic history.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kafila" represents a strong and dedicated woman who takes the journey towards Allah seriously and strives to guide others on their own path towards Him. This name can be seen as a metaphor for the role of community leaders, teachers, and scholars in Islamic culture, who provide guidance and support to those seeking knowledge and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kafila" also holds deep spiritual significance, as it symbolizes the belief that faith and spiritual growth are lifelong journeys. Those carrying this name are seen as beacons of light, traveling steadfastly on the path towards Allah, and inspiring others to do the same through their actions and words. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of remaining committed to one's spiritual pursuits and living a life rooted in faith and obedience to Allah.
